name: BDW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: BDW's own top title changed hands once in the surviving record: “The Irish Bastard” Sean McClancy won the vacant championship in a triple threat over Emilio Dervante and JJ Jarone at the fed's first pay-per-view, The Return I (30 May 2004). A rematch with Dervante was rebooked as a ladder match for 27 June 2004, Anger & Rage; the outcome doesn't survive in the held record, and McClancy was still champion at the fed's own last title snapshot.

name: BDW Broken Championship
notes: Called the “Platinum” title in Brock RockHard's own roleplays #15–16 (5 Jun 2004), the day before and the same week as BDW's own show text calls the same belt “the Broken title” (7th Static, 6 Jun 2004) — read as the same championship under two names rather than two belts, since both name the same champion defending against the same challenger in the same week.
epitaph: Brock RockHard won BDW's Broken Championship in a five-way match at The Return I (30 May 2004), pinning Rob Zone with a set-up inverted DDT while Methid and Pretty Boy Evans never reached the ring. He retained against Rob Zone on the fed's own 7th Static and was still champion at the held record's last title snapshot.

name: BDW Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Arik Caine won BDW's Hardcore Championship at the fed's first pay-per-view, The Return I (30 May 2004), in a Hardcore Elimination Match he closed by pinning Andrew Irving. A week later, on the 7th Static, he refused to defend it against Methid, citing a threatened lawsuit against Co-Owner Jeffery, and the fed's own later title snapshot shows the belt with no listed champion — a title change or vacancy the surviving record doesn't date or explain.

name: BDW Tag Team Championship
notes: No reign survives in the held record — the fed's own title-history ledger and its own later champions snapshot both show the belt without a champion.
epitaph: No Tag Team Championship reign survives in the held record; the belt appears in the fed's own title structure but never with a name against it.
